answer: Self-assessment is cheap to fake upward, so every answer must carry the strongest objection to its own proposal, and jurors check whether that objection is one a real critic would raise. A farm can fire a comet of confident paragraphs, but a genuine counterargument requires modelling someone who disagrees, and cloned models tend to leave the same soft delta between claim and rebuttal. You reach the zenith of the score only by exposing where your mechanism actually breaks, which is knowledge a bought identity simply does not have.
